model.display_name: LungAI DenseNet-121 — Six-Class Chest X-Ray Classifier
model.architecture: DenseNet-121 backbone + GAP + BatchNorm + Dense(256, ReLU) + Dropout(0.3) + Dense(6, softmax)
model.pretrained_weights: imagenet (Keras Applications release weights, downloaded by Keras on first build)

checkpoint.sha256_source: docs/archive/historical_audits/END_TO_END_APPLICATION_TEST_REPORT.md (recorded 2026, not re-verifiable: file not in repository)
checkpoint.availability: NOT IN REPOSITORY. Place the file in models/ (or set MODELS_DIR). The backend refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs unless LUNGAI_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_CHECKPOINT=true.

preprocessing.decode: cv2.imdecode/imread with IMREAD_COLOR (grayscale is replicated to 3 channels; alpha dropped)
preprocessing.note: Filters run at native resolution before resizing (historical order, kept for train/serve parity with the recorded checkpoint). See docs/limitations.md.

training.class_weighting: balanced: n_train / (n_classes * n_train_class), applied as per-sample weights

checkpoint_selection.historical_note: The recorded v5.0 checkpoint was the final epoch of phase 2; validation was evaluated once after training and its value was not saved.

test.permitted_use: Report once; never tune on it

dataset.data_root_note: Manifest image paths are relative to the data root (the folder that contains data/raw and data/downloads).

external_cohort.name: Montgomery County CXR (NLM)
external_cohort.purpose: Independent external assessment; never used for training or model selection
external_cohort.task: binary abnormality (predicted class != Normal) and exact Tuberculosis recall; NOT a six-class evaluation

evaluation.roc_auc_definition: one-vs-rest per class; macro = unweighted mean over the 6 classes (sklearn roc_auc_score multi_class='ovr', average='macro')

inference.confidence_floor_note: Top-class softmax below this is reported as inconclusive. Not clinically validated; softmax is uncalibrated.
